# Sourdough

## Maintaining the starter

Feed equal masses of flour and water. Lactic acid bacteria contribute a tangy aroma.
The float test is unreliable; watch for predictable expansion instead.

## Dough strength

Stretch and fold the dough to strengthen its gluten network.
